**Credit name.** Francisco Couzo ([franciscouzo/square-packing](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing)). Original seed packings, classical constructions and certificate providers retain their credits in the linked manifest.

Follow-up to [#670](https://github.com/jlevy/squares/issues/670).

**Claim.** Please register the **46 improved upper bounds** listed below. Each is strictly smaller than the [previous published repository bound](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/23aff0c6f992271e1ad13a148d44f392c4b386c0/upper_bounds.json) and the reviewed published/classical comparison envelope, including deletion and repeated L borders. The table lists only improved counts below 1024.

**Source commit:** [`af8cb7959aea`](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/commit/af8cb7959aead318c0cf5e9f873de3caa763f77a) — full SHA `af8cb7959aead318c0cf5e9f873de3caa763f77a`.

Other authors’ new pending submissions are credited and used as comparisons rather than claimed as our discoveries. Established Göbel squares/strips and Friedman off-centre constructions, including their L-border consequences, are excluded wherever they match or beat a candidate.

**Certificates.** Each linked certificate is an exact rational unit-square packing. Values below are rounded **upward** to 12 decimal places; exact headers are authoritative. If a selected witness has more squares than the target count, delete the surplus squares. [upper_bounds.json](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/af8cb7959aead318c0cf5e9f873de3caa763f77a/upper_bounds.json) records the exact bound and this relationship. [The manifest](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/af8cb7959aead318c0cf5e9f873de3caa763f77a/certificates/best/manifest.json) retains the source and seed credits, parent hashes and checker receipts.

**Verification.** New or changed witnesses passed exact rational replay using the jlevy/squares corner verifier and this repository’s centre/projection verifier. Both use exact half-angle rotations, separating-axis geometry and conservative spatial prefilters; the implementations share these mathematical ingredients. Identical older certificate bytes retain their earlier verification receipts. The accepted contract is containment in a closed square with disjoint square interiors; boundary contact is allowed. Strict-open verdicts are recorded separately. No optimality or uniqueness is claimed.
